zh: 输入是 1..n 的排列，降序排列后值 v 的位置是唯一确定的：0 基下标 n − v。
把“位置 i 上的值应该去的位置”看成一个置换，它可以分解成若干个环；一次交换最多把一个环拆成两个，长度为 L 的环至少要 L − 1 次交换，而且可以恰好做到。
用访问标记遍历每个未访问的位置，沿着 i → n − a[i] 走完整个环并记录长度 L，答案累加 L − 1；所有环的贡献之和就是最少交换次数。
en: The input is a permutation of 1..n, so in descending order the position of value v is fixed: 0-based index n − v.

Treat "where the value at position i must go" as a permutation; it splits into cycles. One swap splits at most one cycle into two, so a cycle of length L needs at least L − 1 swaps, and that many always suffice.
Use visited flags; from each unvisited position follow i → n − a[i] around its cycle, measure its length L, and add L − 1 to the answer; the sum over all cycles is the minimum number of swaps.

explanationEn:
## Approach

The target position of value v is n−v. Walk every cycle of this position mapping; each cycle of length L contributes L−1.

## Proof of correctness

One swap splits at most one permutation cycle into two, and in the end every position is on its own, so a cycle of length L needs at least L−1 swaps; fixing one position in the cycle and swapping it with the others in turn achieves this. All cycles are independent, so the total is optimal.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(n) space.
